subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps — Horizon AI
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Belmont <sam.belmont@horizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Horizon AI discovery — proposed POC scope & metrics

Hi Sam — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and the proposed POC scope so we can align on success criteria and owners.

Pain points you shared:
- Inconsistent answer quality from current generative layer across our knowledge base (notably product docs & release notes).
- High cost per response at 95th percentile latency due to repeated cold starts and lack of caching.
- Need for auditability and prompt-level evaluation for regulatory reporting.

Goals for the POC (30 days):
1) Reduce median latency for chat flows by 30% vs your current host.
2) Improve helpfulness score on our evaluation prompt set by +15% (relative) measured against your baseline.
3) Demonstrate prefix/KV caching and a fall-back policy that keeps availability above 99.5% during traffic bursts.

Proposed scope & deliverables:
- Dataset & prompts: your product KB + 200 representative user queries (we'll start with the 100 you shared and augment).
- Metrics: latency (p50/p95), cost-per-1K-tokens, helpfulness (evaluation harness), cache hit rate, and error rate.
- Owners: Neha (Redwood AE) / Marissa (Redwood Solutions) / Sam (Horizon PM) / Priya (Horizon Eng).
- Timeline: Kickoff this week (access/setup), 2-week internal tuning, 1-week joint eval, 1-week wrap & SOW sign-off.
- Access/setup: Horizon to provide API keys for the test dataset, S3 access for logs, and a service account for VPC egress allowlist.

Next steps I recommend this week:
1) You confirm the list of 200 prompt examples (you mentioned sending the expanded set to Priya).
2) Priya to provision the test service account + S3 bucket (see checklist attached).
3) I'll share a POC SOW and a DocuSign link for signatures; we can run the POC under the standard trial SOW.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), horizon-access-checklist.xlsx

If that matches your understanding, I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with your eng + PM + our solutions lead (Marissa) for Thursday.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]
[Attachment: horizon-access-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)]

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 11:00am PT (30m) and include a short agenda: intros, setup checklist review, prompt set confirmation, telemetry & metrics expectations.

Looking forward — Neha
